# AI Automation Engineer

Building production-oriented automation systems that connect AI, CRM, and business workflows.

---

## Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|------------|
| Automation Engine | n8n (self-hosted) |
| AI / LLM | OpenAI, GPT models, structured output pipelines |
| Backend | Node.js, Express |
| Frontend | Next.js 14, React, Tailwind |
| Database | PostgreSQL (multi-tenant, RLS) |
| Infrastructure | Docker, Docker Compose, NGINX |
| Observability | Prometheus, Grafana, Loki |
| Messaging | RabbitMQ, Redis |
| Integrations | REST APIs, webhooks, CRM sync |
